about_the_game:
Deathly Reprieve is a unique first-person shooter real-time tactics. Strategize, adapt, and shoot your way through enemy lines. Lead a mercenary organization through a blood-soaked world, as you uncover a global conspiracy. Do you have what it takes?

Game Modes:

  • Single player PVE (Player Versus Environment)

Features:

  • Gun Shooting

  • Real-time tactics

  • Riddles

  • Strategy

  • Blood

  • Friendly Fire

  • Humor

Spoken Languages:

  • English

Subtitles:

  • English


Story:
You play as "The Valencian", a high-ranking officer in a mercenary organization. In a near-futuristic world, scarred by countless apocalyptic events, you thrive on the three things that keep you alive: luxury, violence, and control.

Your organization operates on the fringes of morality, using expendable convicts—broken souls made obedient through torture and brainwashing—to bolster its ranks. You lead these disposable soldiers on brutal missions, carrying out the will of their shadowy employer without question.

But once you stumble upon a secret you were never meant to find, everything changes. Your organization turns against you and your once-privileged life becomes a fight for survival.

Now, with your wits, skills and dwindling resources, you must uncover the truth behind a global conspiracy that threatens to destroy what’s left of the world. Only then you can reclaim your life.

content_descriptors.notes: Violence and gore prevalent throughout the gameplay. Sporadic use of nudity and insinuation of sexual acts.
